g.text: Design an App Users Hate, Yet Have No Choice But to Use
“Every snoozed minute buys drumsticks for your roommates!”
“Every snoozed minute buys drumsticks for your roommates!”
Curse it at 07:00 AM, yet willingly lock ¥50 deposit every night at 23:30!
Smooth “slide-to-stop” alarms indulge half-asleep muscle-memory dismissal. Rise & Fine pairs
5 anti-muscle-memory gauntlets + a 4-roommate zero-sum flywheel — zero cold-start traffic needed!
Zero Platform Cut · Peer Pressure Lock-In
Ditches million-DAU stranger pools for 4 roommates
in 1 physical dorm — everyone hears the alarm.
Kills eyes-closed muscle memory! Dodging sliders,
wipe-on-typo & shuffled math wake the cortex.
Losing ¥5 to an app feels dull; watching your ¥5 buy
drumsticks for Zhang across the room stings 10×.
Five Maddening Yet 100% Deterministically Solvable Gauntlets
Touch without unlocking and the thumb dodges &
taunts; fling too fast and it derails; let go mid-track
for an instant 9.8G gravity snapback to zero.
✓ Clear Path: Hold safety pin 0.8s → steady
Want 5m snooze? Paste is blocked (attempts swap
in a harsher confession), 1 typo wipes everything,
and every 10s hesitation bleeds -¥1 to roommates!
Awake roommates launch ¥10 ambush raids! Sine-
swaying keypad reshuffles 0–9 after every tap.
✓ Solve 2 equations cleanly to survive & keep ¥10
Link matching nodes on 5×5 / 6×6 grids; touching
another color blows both lines & fines ¥0.50.
Slide parked scooters on a 6×6 grid to escort red
car out EXIT; any scrape snaps back & fines ¥0.50!
⚙ Hardcore Engineering · Never Fake Anti-UX with Bugs
RISE & FINE · Wake Up or Buy Drumsticks!
